brand.name: MedBridge
brand.tagline: One verified medication plan. One connected care journey.
brand.subheading: Bilingual Collaborative Healthcare Platform connecting Patients, Doctors, and Care Pharmacists.
brand.disclaimer: MedBridge is a medication coordination and information-support application. It does not replace a doctor, pharmacist, emergency service, diagnosis, examination, or professional medical advice.

warnings.emergency_text: If you are experiencing severe symptoms such as chest pain, severe difficulty breathing, facial swelling, or extreme dizziness, please seek immediate emergency medical care at the nearest hospital rather than waiting for an app response.
warnings.ai_assistant_only: AI is an assistive draft tool only. All medication plans require confirmation by licensed healthcare professionals before reminders are activated.
warnings.reported_availability_note: Inventory numbers are reported estimates from participating community pharmacies and are subject to real-time verification upon reservation.

teach_back.title: Check Your Understanding (Teach-Back)
teach_back.subtitle: In your own words, explain how and when you will take your approved medications.
teach_back.prompt: How will you take this medicine? (e.g. Dose, timing with meals, weekly schedule)
teach_back.submitted: Your explanation has been sent to your pharmacist for review.
